segments.text: Across time and space, music has always been with humanity.
In the age when cave paintings were drawn, people were already playing instruments.
Flutes made of bone, drums with stretched skins
Though primitive, it was certainly music
Music has a mysterious power
Even between people who do not share a language
Melody and rhythm reach the heart directly
Across dialect and borders music
Like a universal language connects people
Ancient Greek philosophers regarded music as a branch of mathematics
They thought the proportion and harmony of sound
Reflected the order of the universe
It may sound like a fancy theory
But today's science too continues to describe the laws of music
On the other hand, modern neurosyns have shown that music stimulates multiple regions of the brain simultaneously
Hearing, movement, memory, emotion, few activities activate the brain as comprehensively as music
Music therapy
is employed even with patients with dementia and depression
even those who have lost their words when they hear a song familiar from their youth
their expressions may return music education should be highlighted in the growth of children
Through learning and instrument, concentration, cooperation, and expression are nurtured
But in recent years, school music education has been shrinking
Budget restrictions is the main reason
With the development of digital technology, an age has come when anyone can create music
And share it with the world
This is wonderful
But at the same time
Music has also come to be treated as mere consumer goods
Music exists not for efficiency
But for the nourishment of the heart
Within our busy days
Let us keep time to listen
Attentively to music
Even one song a day
That is what keeps us human
